name: KGConceptMap
title: Knowledge graph L3: Concept Map
description: A FHIR ConceptMap -- one per target code system in the dictionary's terminology mappings. 8 in the immunizations IG. Records that a mapping exists; the mappings themselves belong to terminology. Class IRI: http://smart.who.int/kg/concept-map.

element.definition: A FHIR ConceptMap -- one per target code system in the dictionary's terminology mappings. 8 in the immunizations IG. Records that a mapping exists; the mappings themselves belong to terminology. Class IRI: http://smart.who.int/kg/concept-map.
The canonical URL. Only a resolved component carries one.
A profile canonical the artefact declares (meta.profile or the requirement's profile).
The computable name: the CamelCase identifier a Canonical() reference matches on.
Where the node was read from: a repository path or URL.
Hash of the file the node was read from; pins the source.
